**Issue #1859 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1859: Patch: Stinkyscape S02, the Starship cards
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape set, a card part. It builds on `main` behind R1420's gate, so no player meets these cards before the release, the last part of #1856.

## Scope

- **Cards**: Dormant Starship, `#90` After Burner, `#106` Warpfield Amplifier, `#131` Spacerace Stimulus, `#133` Ultra Capacitor, `#136` Magic Module, `#137` Firststrike Capability, `#137.1–#137.4` Land, Sea, Air and Space Doctrine, `#144` Prepare For Liftoff
- **Uses, already on `main`**: #1852, #1838

The War Doctrines' Starship lines act once, as the doctrine is cast; their keyword half lasts the rest of the game (the designer's answer).

## Reading

Each card's entry is in the foundation's card-by-card brief (`docs/stinkyscape-set.md` once #1857 has merged); the designer's words are `JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`. The plan's fixes (ST8) and the designer's answers (ST9) win over the designer's words.

## Done when

- Each card's script, `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/cNNN_slug.rs` (filling the foundation's stub), returns `Vec<Effect>` built from the engine's verbs and reads state through the prelude alone (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6), with tests in the same file for its base and its Radiant behaviour and its BUILD M12 rows green.
- A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (`crates/cards/README.md`); a decision the spec does not make gets a ruling note from this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- The cards' own rows (§8.10, §7, BUILD M12, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, the catalog entry) are corrected where the build decides otherwise, and the pull request says so.
- The set stays held by R1420's gate: no pending fragment, no golden trace moves, the shipped totals unchanged.
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST6, ST8, ST9); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

Blocked by #1857

Part of #1856.
```

## Found so far
- #1857 (foundation) merged at 5e04fd9d7: stubs exist in crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/ for
  c090_after_burner, c106_warpfield_amplifier, c131_spacerace_stimulus, c133_ultra_capacitor,
  c136_magic_module, c137_firststrike_capability, c137_1..4 doctrines, c144_prepare_for_liftoff,
  t_dormant_starship (hull flags already, needs tests only).
- Brief: docs/stinkyscape-set.md lines 2119 (#90), 2327 (#106), 2665 (#131), 2691 (#133), 2743 (#136),
  2756-2819 (#137, #137.1-4), 2899 (#144), 3367 (Dormant Starship); ST14 A15..A40.
- Rulings on main: R1852000-R1852007 (Starship), R1839000-3 (Dormant), R1838000-3 (Tradable),
  R1857000-3 (foundation), R1748001 (dealsDamage).
- NEW engine work per brief: (1) CatalogQuery field for dealsDamage (Magic Module); (2) a rest-of-game
  player modifier lending a keyword to every Unit its caster controls (the four Doctrines).
- Rulings block: R1859000..R1859999. 11-rulings.md gets a paragraph (format: line 646 R1857000).
- catalog.json `loc` per entry must equal `cargo jackioh catalog loc <path>` (new entries; tools test
  crates/tools/src/catalog.rs ~2763). Card part updates its own `loc` (docs/ADDING_CARDS.md line 43).
- No fragment, no stated totals (held set). Card metrics lists unpinned (fine).
- Rows to correct where build differs: spec/08-catalog.md lines 674,690,716,718,722-727,734,770;
  spec/07-tokens.md 125-128; BUILD.md 1267,1283,1309,1311,1315-1320,1327,1363; docs/radiant-audit.md
  792,808,834,836,840-845,852,888.

## Engine facts verified
- starship.rs: `when_launched(id, run) -> TriggerDef` (ctx.self_ = the Starship), `building_a_ship(state,p)`,
  `dormant_starship_of(state,p) -> Option<&CardInstance>`, `launched_starship_of(state,p)`,
  `starship_pieces_of(&CardInstance) -> Vec<StarshipPieceRecord{def_id, radiant: Option<bool>}>`.
  launch(): Starship keyword granted, name, memory.launched=seq, StarshipLaunched{player,instance_id,def_id,
  name,pieces} pushed, then trigger_cry_of (inline, prompts park work); When launched triggers run after
  work drains.
- player_mods.rs: ModifierKind in state.rs ~560-680; add_modifier(ctx, player, expiry, kind);
  `starship_launch_costs(StarshipLaunchCostArgs{cost})`.
- Traps = `triggers: vec![TriggerDef::new(id,&[GameEventType::X], run).with_when(..)]` (C #14 Shadowstep).
  GameEvent::Destroyed{instance_id, def_id, owner, controller, attack, max_health, killer_id, radiant}.
- Discover then cast pattern: M+ #25 c025_kys_intuition.rs (discover_from_catalog step + resume map);
  cast_new(CastNewArgs{def, radiant, how}) in effects/cast.rs:265.
- Firststrike order: Cry [awaken, discover] -> Doctrine cast resolves BEFORE fused When launched
  triggers (work drains before trigger queue, R113) -> needs a ruling.

- BUG FOUND: TriggerDef.when is only read for traps (traps.rs:388); triggers.rs dispatch never checks it.
  So `when_launched`'s own-ship filter is dead for a launched Starship on the field: its fused When
  launched hooks re-run on any later starshipLaunched (opponent's). Fix in starship.rs `when_launched`:
  repeat the check inside the run wrapper. Engine test in tests/rules/starship.rs named r1852003_….
- New modifier: `ModifierKind::UnitsHaveKeyword { keyword: Keyword }` (expiry Never), read in
  layers.rs compute_layers after aura keywords (line ~498), only when not dormant/slumbering and
  `zones::in_units_row_or_standing`; Vanilla still takes it (R115, §10.4 formula) -> correct §8.10 rows
  "a Vanilla not taking it". view_for.rs modifier_label arm (exhaustive match, line ~1235) with
  `crate::wire::keyword_key`. Verb in effects/player_mods.rs `give_units_keyword(GiveUnitsKeywordArgs{keyword})`.
  Regenerates apps/web/src/wire/generated/ModifierKind.ts, PlayerModifier.ts; and
  crates/cards/luau/jackioh.luau via `cargo test -p jackioh-luau --features ts --test export_api`.
  spec/10-engine-guide.md line 50 (mods list) and 150 (keyword formula) get the new term.
- Magic Module: add `deals_damage: Option<bool>` to CatalogQueryArgs (catalog.rs ~417, From impl ~494,
  matches_query ~ after tribute), reading `def.deals_damage == Some(true)`; test in tests/rules/pools.rs.

## TODO
- agents: Starship API/tests pattern; verbs; modifier/keyword layer
